svg.text: SMARTBOW AI — 1:1 CALIBRATED ARUCO FIDUCIAL PRINT SHEET
OPENCV DICT_4X4_50 SPECIFICATION · PRECISION RESEARCH PRINT SPEC
MANDATORY: PRINT AT 100% SCALE (ACTUAL SIZE) · DO NOT FIT TO PAGE

g.text: PHYSICAL 100.0 mm SCALE BAR — VERIFY WITH VERNIER CALIPER BEFORE CUTTING
PASS: Reads 100.0 ± 0.5 mm | FAIL: Scale distorted by printer driver margins
1. OCCLUSAL RIM BUCCAL TARGET ARRAYS (18.0 × 18.0 × 3.0 mm)
Affix onto right buccal premolar surface with sticky wax & 0.8mm wire tag. Clearance: ≥5mm from occlusal table.
2. FACIAL REFERENCE MARKERS (14.0 × 14.0 mm ON ADHESIVE BACKING)
Establish patient cranial coordinate frame. Affix to skin with hypoallergenic adhesive dots.
3. CAMERA INTRINSICS CALIBRATION TARGET (60.0 × 60.0 mm RIGID CARD)
3×3 ArUco array for calculating pinhole focal length (fx, fy) and optical principal center (cx, cy). Mount flat on acrylic.
1. Paste 60×60mm card onto rigid flat cardboard or acrylic.
2. Hold card at 45–50 cm distance under uniform diffuse lighting.
3. Software requires all 9 markers detected across 10 poses.
4. Reprojection error must satisfy < 0.50 px root-mean-square.
System remains in UNCALIBRATED estimation mode until the 3×3 card
is successfully scanned. Pinhole intrinsics are mandatory for metric VDO.
Status: Calibration records timestamp, focal length & optical center.
Maitri College of Dentistry & Research Centre · Dept. of Prosthodontics · Dr. Deepanshu
